title: partition_owner state record body
description: Which host owns one partition of a team, or which host is giving it up. An owned partition's host serves the agents placed in it, and its NATS credential names the partition; a released partition's host is handing it over and gets no credential that names it again. Its signed sequence is the fencing token, as a placement's is.

state.description: owned: the host owns the partition, and the authority names it in the host's NATS credential. released: the team services are moving the partition away from the host; the authority leaves it out of every credential it issues from then on, a renewal by the host needs a new NATS key, and no new agent is placed in it (README, "Credentials follow ownership").

host.description: The host that owns the partition, or, when released, the host giving it up.

host_epoch.description: The membership epoch of the host's certificate when it was given the partition. Renewals do not move the partition: a reader accepts the record while the host's liveness record names a certificate of that runtime at this epoch or later.

assigned_at.description: When the team services gave the host the partition, or released it.

reason.description: Why the host was given the partition, or why it is released.
